notes.title: Ayasa: Shadows of Silence 0.9 Update Now Live
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We’ve just dropped Big Demo Update 0.9 for Ayasa: Shadows of Silence!

New Gameplay Ability

Add brand-new gameplay abilities. Now you can lift objects with special ability.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248538/8859c2d4be4e94abffc1fa42b915b3edcee3be35.gif

New Cutscenes & Character Improvements.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248538/35962088bffee85947abdb6bdbe7a39eacc138d5.gif

New cutscenes that deepen the story, Hair Physics Ayasa’s movement now feels more alive with fully integrated hair physics.



Bug Fixes

 Fixed collision issues in multiple areas

 Reduce loading time in certain areas.

 Addressed minor visual glitches


Known Issues

Some players have experienced occasional crashes during the demo.
This is linked to an Unreal Engine issue, and while we're actively working on a fix, it's important to remember that this is an early demo  and some hiccups are normal at this stage.

 Please consider adding the game to your wishlist and explore the latest demo. Every piece of feedback is invaluable in helping us refine and enhance our game for your enjoyment.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3146120/Ayasa_Shadows_of_Silence/

notes.title: Ayasa: Shadows of Silence - Major Update Demo 0.3 Unleashed!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248538/90ccbed4052b0347f315b3671ff0f29254a9739c.jpg
We're excited to roll out Demo 0.3 for Ayasa: Shadows of Silence! This update brings comprehensive improvements across the board to enhance your gaming experience. Key changes include:

[olist]
Overall Game Optimization: Streamlined performance for a smoother experience.
Critical Bug Fix: Addressed the crash bug for uninterrupted play.
Improved Loading Times: Quicker transitions to keep you in the action.
Enemy AI Enhancements: Smarter, more challenging adversaries.
Game Menu Bugs and Improvements: Refined user interface for better navigation.
New Game Save Slots: More flexibility to save and resume your adventure.
Revamped Game Menu: An overhauled menu for easier access to all features.
Updated Control Systems: Enhanced keyboard and gamepad support for optimal control.
Gameplay and Mechanics Improvements:** Fine-tuned game mechanics for a more engaging experience.
Jump Bug Fix: Resolved an issue preventing jumping capabilities.
Camera Distance Fix: Adjusted camera settings for better gameplay perception.
Game Size Optimization: Reduced physical size without compromising quality.
Performance Enhancements: Boosted performance to handle more complex scenes.
[/olist]

We're committed to continuously improving Ayasa to deliver the best possible experience. Enjoy the new features and optimizations, and thank you for your support!

notes.title: Demo Update 0.2.1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248538/118070b6f917622da8b0ed238ba65c680a8a59e1.png

**Event Description:**

1. **Introduction to Update 0.2.1:** We're thrilled to announce the release of Demo Update 0.2.1, focused on enhancing your gaming experience with multiple improvements and fixes.

2. **Key Updates:** 
   - **Bug Fixes:** Addressing critical bugs for smoother gameplay.
   - **Log Fixes:** Improved log functionalities for better game tracking.
   - **Camera Update:** Enhanced camera mechanics for a more immersive experience.
   - **Mechanic Fix on Lake:** Specific updates to game mechanics in the lake area to enhance interaction and realism.
   - **Language Fix:** Expanded and refined language support to cater to our global community.
   - **Credit Update:** Updated credits to acknowledge the contributions of our dedicated team and community.

3. **Invitation to Update:** Update your game to version 0.2.1 now to enjoy these enhancements and continue your adventure with improved functionality and fewer interruptions.

4. **Feedback Request:** As always, we value your feedback! After updating, please let us know your thoughts and any further improvements you'd like to see in future updates.

notes.title: Demo Update 0.2 Now Available!
notes.content:
Thank you for your ongoing support and feedback. Here are the detailed updates for Demo Update 0.2

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248538/c4d9a1fc177dd91347c7d8160494ba3b7d5f3c71.png

Story Progression Bugs Fixed Resolved technical issues that previously halted story progression, ensuring a smoother narrative experience.

Collider Enhancements Refined colliders within the project for more accurate interactions and improved physics responses.

Gamepad Selection Feature: Added a feature to manually select gamepads, as the system does not automatically detect the connected controller yet.

Minor Gameplay Errors Corrected Addressed and fixed minor gameplay bugs to enhance overall player experience.

Optimization Improvements Enhanced project optimization with additional updates scheduled for release this Saturday.

Full Steam Deck Support 
 Integrated full support for the Steam Deck, optimizing compatibility and performance.

Camera Functionality Upgrade Improved camera functionality to ensure smoother movement and better control.

Please check out Demo Update 0.2 and let us know your thoughts!

notes.title: New Details Revealed About Ayasa's Darkest Foes
notes.content:
Former Humans

These are Former Humans from once-thriving countries who have been tragically transformed into mutants. Their pats lives are lost, leaving them as twisted remnants of what they once were, now driven 
by an unnatural force.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248538/1844cd96f69d97a31b287288156f5122da4ed062.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248538/63432c73c5d1c58fadf1d75c0fa099dd1b0fda97.jpg

Relentless Hunter

A relentless hunter of the forest, this mutant stalks its prey with sharp instincts and deadly precision.
It attacks anything that crosses its path, and once it catches sight of you, there's no escape.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248538/5087edec697ccb377c478fb7d9574f91ecc7061e.jpg

Other Characters

notes.content:
